Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral Ti centers coordinated by six O neighbors, and octahedral Li centers coordinated by six O neighbors, with O centers showing four- or five-coordinate environments. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component containing all 36 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and edge-sharing between Li and Ti octahedra and among Li octahedra.
